title: Two days in Quy Nhon
summary: The crescent and Xuân Diệu on the first day, then Eo Gió and Kỳ Co across Thị Nại. Ghềnh Ráng, about 3 km south, is the other day if you skip the peninsula.

days.title: Day 1 — Crescent and the bridge
days.body: Swim the free yellow crescent, eat bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ, walk Nguyễn Tất Thành square after dark, and cross or photograph Thị Nại. The beach visit is about an hour and a beach day is longer. The bridge visit is about 30 minutes, and it is a road, not a ticketed walk.

days.title: Day 2 — The peninsula
days.body: Eo Gió, then Kỳ Co. Eo Gió is 25,000 đồng, and a child under 0.9 m is free. Kỳ Co is posted as 30,000–60,000 đồng, and that range does not say what it buys, so read the board. If you would rather stay south of the center, Ghềnh Ráng is about 3 km and free.

stops.name: City beach
stops.note: Swim the free yellow crescent between 6:00 and 23:00, and allow about an hour even though a beach day runs longer.

approach.note: Walk from the center onto the crescent.

stops.name: Bun cha ca
stops.note: Eat bún chả cá on Nguyễn Huệ between the swim and the bridge.

stops.name: Thi Nai bridge
stops.note: Allow about 30 minutes to cross or photograph the span.

stops.name: Eo Gio
stops.note: Allow about 30 minutes at the saddle, where the fee is 25,000 đồng.

stops.name: Ky Co
stops.note: Allow about an hour, and read the 30,000–60,000 đồng board before you pay.

additions.name: Ghenh Rang
additions.note: Take the egg-stone cove about 3 km south, free, if you skip the peninsula.
